_about: Every public-domain Stephen Charnock (1628-1680) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is Nichol's Complete Works (Nichol's Series of Standard Divines, 5 vols, 1864-1866, introduction by James M'Cosh, d. 1894), Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted, one scan series, each volume number read off its title page; vols 1-2 carry the Existence and Attributes of God. CCEL ThML is fetched for its six Charnock discourses (clean). No Gutenberg Charnock found. Not to be confused with Richard Stephen Charnock (1820-1904), the etymologist, who fills most IA results for the name.
